description: Percentage homes with broadband less than 2Mbit/s - WMCA is a dataset listed in Birmingham City Observatory open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ofcom. This metric shows the percentage of homes with broadband in an area currently not achieving 2Mbit/s speeds. It has been produced by Ofcom, using data provided by communications providers and is one of a series of measures Ofcom use to determine fixed broadband performance within an area. Coverage: West Midlands Combined Authority area, including Birmingham. The portal files it under Connected City. Its keywords are west midlands combined authority, wmca, broadband, internet, city vision. The portal shows 72 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cityobservatory-birmingham-gov-uk-portal.
